scope: P16 DOCX bounded continuous document preview: parser/typed client/Worker and controlled browser verification; root owns production UI; verification owns Rust capture.

interfaces.ipc: file_delivery_read_docx, immutable VerifiedFile + entries + inert base64 parts + inflatedBytes
interfaces.worker: Dedicated module Worker: bounded OPC/XML parse, PNG/JPEG image decode, closed typed data; fixed error codes only
interfaces.client: Exact VerifiedFile ownership, immediate abort/release, 10-second deadline, ignore late Worker results, validate closed response before UI

dependencyChanges: None; existing saxes and image_bytes reused without global behavior changes.
capability: Body source order; literal zero/false/empty/space; basic style inheritance; list start/restart; ordinary and nested bounded tables with horizontal/vertical merges; package PNG/JPEG including EXIF 1–8; explicit header/footer/footnote/endnote stories; cached field results with missing/unsupported notices.

targetedValidation.qualification: Run by this subagent. No repeated full repository checks or production build.

browserValidation.scope: Chromium real Worker with actual Rust capture JSON, authored captures, and explicit idle Worker for deadline. Not installed WebKit/Tauri IPC or Word pagination.
React StrictMode production DOCX UI, real Chromium Worker and codecs, controlled IPC captures. Not installed app.
Actual Chromium Worker and HTML image decode, asymmetric RGBY quadrant pixel checks for Exif1..8. No user image/native app.

browserBoundaries: Real Chromium module Worker, codecs and React StrictMode; controlled Tauri invoke/opener only; no formal app, Agent or account.
Worker starts from separately recorded actual Rust read_docx capture for authored sample 05; its temporary file no longer exists. Other inputs are test-only capture conversion; not real Tauri IPC.
Five unchanged maintainer public DOCX fixtures and three unchanged python-docx writer documents parsed successfully; rejection fixtures are not counted as normal document support.
WebKit/native installed DOCX remains untested here. Continuous block/table windows are not Word page layout.
